sources.excerpt: La Scatola Nero - **Builder:** Stomp Under Foot - **Catalog type:** Fuzz - **Identity:** Stomp Under Foot La Scatola Nero octave-fuzz pedal. La Scatola Nero is a fuzz pedal with an added octave function. Contemporary exact-model records identify it as an octave-fuzz design developed after a request from Ben McLeod of All Them Witches for a different fuzz with an octave added. - Exact factory colorway sequence was not established from the sources reviewed. - **La Scatola Nero:** exact cataloged model. - Fuzz + octave architecture. - No separately numbered factory revision established from the available exact-model records. - No documented production revision split established. - **Exact production transistor/device:** Not established in the available exact-model sources. - **Exact clipping/rectification diode:** Not established in the available exact-model sources. The model combines a fuzz voice with an added octave function, giving it a more aggressive upper-register texture than a conventional fuzz alone. Exact-model descriptions tie the concept directly to the request for a distinct fuzz with an octave function rather than simply transferring specifications from another Stomp Under Foot circuit. 1.
